card.line: Corinth was a wealthy Greek city where Paul stayed to teach about Jesus and started a church, and he later wrote two letters to the believers there.

moments.title: Paul Arrives in Corinth
moments.text: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth. There he met Aquila and Priscilla, who were tentmakers like him, and he stayed and worked with them.

moments.title: Teaching in the Synagogue
moments.text: Every Sabbath Paul reasoned in the synagogue, telling Jews and Greeks that Jesus is the Christ. When some opposed and insulted him, he left and went next door to the house of Titus Justus, a worshiper of God.

moments.title: A Letter to the Church
moments.text: Paul wrote to the church of God in Corinth. He thanked God for the grace given to them in Christ Jesus.

moments.title: A Second Letter of Comfort
moments.text: Paul wrote again to the church in Corinth. He praised God as the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort.

moments.title: Why Paul Did Not Return
moments.text: Paul said he did not come back to Corinth in order to spare them. He wrote through many tears to show how much he loved them.
